pick_word.subtitle: Calm Kat down! Don't upset her!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you rather see in charge of the popular clique?
Have you ever been chosen as a king, queen, prince or princess?

nodes.text: Taylor gently touches Hector on the arm and looks at him with her soft eyes. Hector turns down the music sheepishly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector! You're having girl trouble, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... I never said that I had girl trouble!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: C'mon. You're singing 'Single Girlie'. That's the girl-power song for the recently broken up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be discreet. Confidentiality is my specialty. I'm not like Paula.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay... Don't repeat this to anyone...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm kind of hung up on a girl, but she already has a boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hmm... Linda? No... Kat? No... Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No eekin' way! `Amanda?` She's not your type!
nodes.text_bbcode: No eekin' way! [color=#3b78e2][i]Amanda?[/i][/color] She's not your type!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Of course... I'm sure it's just that's she's so `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Of course... I'm sure it's just that's she's so [color=#e23b3b][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... That's it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa! He actually `likes` her! I've never seen Hector like this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! He actually [color=#3b78e2][i]likes[/i][/color] her! I've never seen Hector like this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe I can make this work to my advantage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know... She's been having trouble with Zach lately... I can talk to her...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Really? You could? Could you find out if she likes me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, man. Listen to me. I'm pathetic! I'm wishy-washy... Obsessed... Whiny...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm turning into Howard!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahhh! No! Not that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um... There, there, Hector. It'll be all right. I'll talk to her. You keep spinning.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. The party is the DJ's responsibility. Have to keep spinning. Must... Keep... Spinning...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha! I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... Now that I've been honest... Maybe I can get you to vote for me for Winter Queen?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You just admitted you hate my boyfriend and one of my best friends!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But... I was... Honest.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right. And I'm being honest too.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't like people who don't like my friends.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So I'll be voting for `Spud` at the dance... Just like I did for Homecoming Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: So I'll be voting for [color=#3b78e2][i]Spud[/i][/color] at the dance... Just like I did for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You... You were?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As hard as it is for me to admit it, I've always been jealous of you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just so smart and nice... And so many boys like you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow... I never thought someone like `you` would be jealous of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... I never thought someone like [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] would be jealous of me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is working perfectly! She actually believes me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now to put on the final touches...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I was just being so mean because... I didn't feel good about myself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... I didn't realize that... It sounds like you need a boost!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do to cheer you up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, now that you mention it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You `could` vote for me for Winter Queen.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]could[/i][/color] vote for me for Winter Queen.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I bet winning would really help my self-esteem!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Okay. At least this way I won't be voting for Paula.
After school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey... It's Linda...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Everyone` likes her... I bet she could get a bunch of her friends to vote for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Everyone[/i][/color] likes her... I bet she could get a bunch of her friends to vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But she hasn't talked to me since Paula and I gave her that ultimatum about Howard and Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is going to take some finesse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Linda. I wanted to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um, I thought you and Paula kicked me out of the popular crowd.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! I've `always` wanted you as a friend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! I've [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] wanted you as a friend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's just Paula who doesn't like you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She threatened to spread a rumor that I had false teeth if I didn't say those things to you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And what about Howard and Kenji, huh? Those guys are my friends!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... I'll admit...

options.label: I don't like Howard and Kenji.
I was jealous that Howard and Kenji liked you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you even hang out with Zach anymore?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sometimes... When he's not working out, or playing sports, or playing with his Q-Box...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't want to tell you to dump him, but it doesn't sound like you guys are very happy...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course we're happy! We're dating!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I mean is when you two `are` hanging out, do you like him?
nodes.text_bbcode: What I mean is when you two [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] hanging out, do you like him?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: When we're making out, I do!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Except when he's got protein-shake breath...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, I just want you to find some guy you're happy with!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're such a great friend, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent... Now I just have to hope my advice will work its slow magic...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And when Amanda `does` go for Hector, I'll make sure he knows he's got me to thank for it.
nodes.text_bbcode: And when Amanda [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] go for Hector, I'll make sure he knows he's got me to thank for it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Score a vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think you should dump Zach and go after Hector.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... But... Zach's my boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but Hector's cute, and nice, and funny!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But Zach would be so sad if he found out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Simple! Don't tell Zach. You can have both guys!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I can't lie to my boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have you told him about the kisses?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then you can keep on not telling Zach about Hector. You'll be happy, Hector will be happy, and Zach will be happy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But that would be cheating! That's worse than lying!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it isn't! That's having your cake and eating it too!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't understand! Is Hector the 'cake' or the 'two'?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Zach is the cake... And Hector is the frosting!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm so confused! Now I want cake, but I'm trying to lose weight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... I mean... Er... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot... I'm not sure she's any closer to dumping Zach for Hector...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which means I'm no closer to winning Hector's vote!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow... Hector seemed really desperate. He went from hot to not `so` fast!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... Hector seemed really desperate. He went from hot to not [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] fast!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Is Hector ugly now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's still hot on the outside... In a lower-class, one night hookup, never tell your friends about it kind of way.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But he's acting really weird!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! It's my fault!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't be `ridonculous.` How could it be your fault?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't be [color=#3b78e2][i]ridonculous.[/i][/color] How could it be your fault?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I can't say... It's too horrible...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... I don't have to know...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I have to tell someone! I keep `feeling` one thing, but I'm `thinking` another!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I have to tell someone! I keep [color=#3b78e2][i]feeling[/i][/color] one thing, but I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]thinking[/i][/color] another!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I've never had to do that before!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I even have to ask, or are you going to tell me anyway?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Er... Don't tell Zach, but I accidentally kissed Hector...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Twice!
Taylor turns down the volume on the turntable.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, you never touch a man's audio equipment without his permission!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I only want to figure out why you're in such obvious pain!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! I know! It's because of your hair!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! What's wrong with my hair?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... It's kind of overly-gelled.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... I was going for an angled bob thing...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Angled bob? Isn't that an emo style?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... Oh no! It is! Great Grandmaster Flush, I've gone `emo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Oh no! It is! Great Grandmaster Flush, I've gone [color=#e23b3b][i]emo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's wrong with me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm becoming even more emo by asking myself if I'm emo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahhh!!!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Back up slowly, Taylor. Don't let anyone see you with him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahhh!!!
Taylor runs for it!
Later in the day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... The Winter Dance is only a week away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's not much time to campaign...  It'll take a lot of legwork.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good thing I have great legs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great... That reminds me of the time Paula had my leg broken... I'd better keep an eye out for her...
Taylor enters the cafeteria, where Hector is spinning some tunes to pump people up for the Winter Formal.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector is friends with a lot of people... If I can get `him` to vote for me, it would really boost my campaign.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector is friends with a lot of people... If I can get [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] to vote for me, it would really boost my campaign.

nodes.speaker: Music
nodes.text: I'm a single girlie! I'm a single girlie!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: { I'm a single girlie! I'm a single girlie! {

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! No sneaking up on the DJ!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector, but did I see you shaking your butt to 'Single Girlie'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: N... No! I was just... Jumping on a spider?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hm... Something's up. My girl-sense detects a boy-secret...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector...
He turns up the music!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, I can't hear you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's not going to dodge me that easily!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... Thinking hurts...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Try. For once. I want to be in charge, but Paula's in charge now, so what does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I... I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, how can I plot against Paula if you and I aren't on the same page?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Reading hurts!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor. I wish I was as smart as you... And... I...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniff!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... You can stop thinking now, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay! Let's look at pictures of dresses!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Looks like if I want to be Winter Queen, I'd better get started by myself!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your turn to look at the catalog?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! It's my turn to rule the school... To be the Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You should! You'd be great at it! You're always telling me what to do.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... Do I? That makes me sound like Paula...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're way nicer than she is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You would never tell me to do anything icky.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... Of course...

nodes.title: Winter Queen
nodes.subtitle: Will you rule the Winter Court?

nodes.text: This week, the Winter Formal promises a great night of dancing, music, and romance for the Centerscore High kids!
And the Dance Planning Committee promises to organize and administrate the dance smoothly and efficiently.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: All right. Next on the agenda! How much money is left in the budget to pay for my tiara?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You haven't won the vote for Winter Queen yet, Paula. We haven't even opened the ballot.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: The vote is only a formality! I know I've practically won already!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No offense, but you said the same thing before Homecoming... And we all know how `that` turned out.
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, but you said the same thing before Homecoming... And we all know how [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] turned out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or did you conveniently forget what happened with $Emily?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I told you never to mention that name around me again...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Besides, she transferred back to Fulliard...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: There will be no one to stop me this time.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm at the height of my popularity, and becoming `Winter Queen` will solidify my position!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm at the height of my popularity, and becoming [color=#3b78e2][i]Winter Queen[/i][/color] will solidify my position!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Height of popularity? That can't be right... Everyone I know hates Paula!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So if there are no further objections... You two can spend the next hour picking out my dress from this catalog!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Good! No objections!
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Her dress is going to be so beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, are you really going to let her keep treating us like this?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course! That's the way it's always been!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look... No offense... But I'm not interested in your guy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See... He's kind of gross and oily. Like... Oil.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm well-moisturized. Like water.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And oil and water just don't mix!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That... That actually makes good scientific sense.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, just to throw out a little inside information...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I happen to know that Paula has `incredibly` oily skin.
nodes.text_bbcode: I happen to know that Paula has [color=#3b78e2][i]incredibly[/i][/color] oily skin.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, I'm not saying she's hooking up with your guy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I `did` see her eat a french fry yesterday.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] see her eat a french fry yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And the whole time she was eating it, she was saying 'you're the second tastiest Spud I know!'

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Why that little...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: By the time I'm done with her, she'll be wishing she still `had` a face to be oily!
nodes.text_bbcode: By the time I'm done with her, she'll be wishing she still [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] a face to be oily!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Remember this little chat when you're voting for Winter Queen!
Later that day, Taylor tries her best to ignore Paula...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Taylor! Passing love notes in class is not an acceptable way to use lab time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But... Ms. Prez... I haven't been passing love notes!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Then why do I have a note from you to... 'Your Snookems, Spud'?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Snicker!

nodes.speaker: The Whole Room
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right... Apparently this rumor can't be stopped...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That means it's time for 'Plan B'...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A counter-attack!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here's the deal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You do a little favor for me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I won't tell everyone that you made out with the entire Wilson High basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I didn't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: People will believe what I tell them to believe!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What... What do you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're going to tell people you saw Spud making out with Paula in the girls' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But... But Spud is my friend. Kat would kill him!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I guess you care more about Spud than your relationship with Darren... Too bad.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No... Wait... I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But you're a horrible person!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can live with that!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're worse than Paula!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Watch it, nerd girl! I will bury you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... Me, worse than Paula? That can't be right...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It has to be hard to see him. I bet you have to hide a lot.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's really rough! But Darren's worth it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He's definitely a better boyfriend than Spud!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Listen... Let's make a deal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can tell you about a bunch of spots in town that are perfect for secret dates...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And since I'm helping you out... Maybe you can make sure everyone knows Spud and I never kissed?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sure thing. I'm not exactly thrilled that a stupid rumor about my ex is circulating the school either.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Besides, it's easy to counter the rumor... Spud doesn't like blondes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Blondes always remind him of shadow elves in 'Warscrewdriver: Online'...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And he can never defeat them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! Now, do you want spots to make out in, trendy but unknown restaurants, or relaxed and romantic hideaways?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ooo! I'll take all of the above!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Can you guarantee that no one will find out?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I haven't used these spots in a while...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And the 'Taylor Love Tour' is `guaranteed` to improve your love life!
nodes.text_bbcode: And the 'Taylor Love Tour' is [color=#3b78e2][i]guaranteed[/i][/color] to improve your love life!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor. You're nicer than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just make sure you do your best to negate the Spud rumor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And remember this chat when you're casting your vote for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I'm definitely not getting help from Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who else can I talk to in order to nullify Paula's rumor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hm... Spud dated Angie before he dated Kat...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That info might be useful...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There she is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's talking on the phone...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little eavesdropping can't hurt...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, hon. I can't wait to see you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right, Darren.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Darren?! From Wilson High?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you dating a Wilson guy?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I... I don't... You... How?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It doesn't matter how I know! You can't date a Wilson guy. They're our mortal enemies!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Please... Don't tell anyone!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I don't want to make this complicated. I'll find another way to end Paula's rumor.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm sorry I'm such a bad friend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No you're not. I shouldn't even have asked you to risk your relationship with Zach for me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can beat Paula myself.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do you need a hug?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure. It couldn't hurt.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hugs make people happy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They do. Thanks, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda. I need you to do this for me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But what happens if Zach finds out? He'll be so mad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Leave the thinking to me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I'm the one who has to do the feeling!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then maybe it's time for you to toughen up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Every time I see Zach, I would have to think of a lie!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not if he never asks you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... He will! Zach is so much smarter than me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A `rock` is smarter than you.
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]rock[/i][/color] is smarter than you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I can't believe you said that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Zach and Paula say that all the time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But `you're` my friend!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] my friend!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I have to go!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you... Are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No! I just have... Tears... In my eyes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That could have gone better...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's no way I'd ever be caught dead with Spud!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're `complete` opposites!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]complete[/i][/color] opposites!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: And if you know `anything` about magnetization, you'll know that opposites attract!
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you know [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] about magnetization, you'll know that opposites attract!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Wait... I mean... It's like...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm like the moon. And he's the earth. We're constantly avoiding each other!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: The moon is attracted by the earth's gravitational pull!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Just know this, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Things can be `very` unpleasant for girls who go after my guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Things can be [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] unpleasant for girls who go after my guy.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You remember Rebecca from last year?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um... No?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I'll be seeing you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great... This `definitely` isn't going to help squash that rumor...
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... This [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] isn't going to help squash that rumor...

nodes.text: The next day, after the Dance Planning Committee meeting adjourns...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Don't think that I don't know what you are doing, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What... Sweet, innocent, lil' ol' me?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You think I'm just going to roll over and let you steal the Winter Queen tiara off of my head!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, think again.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'm taking this up to the next level.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: How many people are going to vote for you after they hear you made out with Spud at Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! I never kissed Spud!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I know that. You know that. But does the `school` know that?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know that. You know that. But does the [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] know that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paula... It doesn't have to be this way.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh, yes, it does.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: So I'm giving you one last chance to change your mind, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Drop out... We can forget this little transgression.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Otherwise, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd `love` to watch you try.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to watch you try.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Fine! Good luck with your new boyfriend Spud!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's no way a fake rumor like that will catch on.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's nothing to worry about... Is there?
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You! You... Succubus!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did you just say I suck?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: No! I called you a man-stealing, lifeforce-destroying `succubus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I called you a man-stealing, lifeforce-destroying [color=#3b78e2][i]succubus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh oh... This is about Spud, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You admit it?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa... I've got to try to explain this in geek language before this crazy girl goes ballistic!

rounds.subtitle: Calm Kat down! Don't upset her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, Megan, Kenji is `totally` cool with me spreading this rumor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Megan, Kenji is [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] cool with me spreading this rumor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact, the rumor makes Kenji look better! He got double-crossed by one of his own, not just some sneaky Wilson guy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's no way he could have seen that coming!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I... I guess that makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm just tired of popular girls messing with Kenji's head! First, it was $Emily... Then Linda... And now you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look... I had nothing to do with $Emily and Linda.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know how much you hate it when I make assumptions about all of you Auto-Shop kids...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So maybe `you` should quit assuming us popular girls are all the same!
nodes.text_bbcode: So maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] should quit assuming us popular girls are all the same!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's actually a pretty good point.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, I guess I'm not going to beat you up.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Too bad... I was really looking forward to it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for not hitting me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And think of me when you're voting for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You really shouldn't scrunch up your face like that... It'll give you wrinkles.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you definitely don't want those... Especially when you already have old-lady hair.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's it, blondie. I'm going to rip all of `your` hair out and sell it as a wig!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it, blondie. I'm going to rip all of [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] hair out and sell it as a wig!

nodes.text: One hair-pulling fight and a nurse's office visit later...

nodes.speaker: Nurse
nodes.text: And you're going to need hair extensions... I'll write you up a prescription.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My mom says I'm in an HMO...

nodes.speaker: Nurse
nodes.text: You belong to a 'Hair Management Organization'? Okay, just give me your card.
The next day, Taylor spends all of her time spreading the rumor about Paula.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...And after she and Alexei stole the float, Paula was like, 'Let's make out next to the Lizard cage!'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Paula made out with a Wilson guy in front of our mascot!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Lyle the Lizard's blood must have been `boiling!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Lyle the Lizard's blood must have been [color=#3b78e2][i]boiling![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aren't lizards cold-blooded?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paula is the cold-blooded one.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Totally...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hehe. Negative campaigning is `fun!` Maybe I should go into politics after high school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. Negative campaigning is [color=#3b78e2][i]fun![/i][/color] Maybe I should go into politics after high school!

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... Who else can I convince to vote for me instead of Paula?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, prep!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Do you need something?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why are you messing with Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not. He and I had a little talk.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then why are you spreading rumors about the float?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The rumor is about Paula.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, but we lost the float on Kenji's watch. People are saying that Paula outsmarted Kenji, and now he looks like a moron!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Megan wouldn't hit me, would she? I have to calm her down! I'm too pretty to get beaten up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay... I'll do it for you, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! Let's go over the story and make sure you understand it front and back.
Two painful, painful hours later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: C'mon, Amanda! You can do it. Try it again!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... Saw... Paula... Stealing... The... Zach?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The float! The float!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't remember this! It's too hard!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... Can't... Do... It!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda! Come back here! Stop crying!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Waaaaah!!!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know... I don't want to drag you into this feud. The less you know the better.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Can I know even less? Would that be good?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, how is that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What were we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Unicorns?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Want to look for pictures of Xac Effon on the internet again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's yummy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Fun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess this is why Amanda is my best friend. She's not complicated.

nodes.speaker: Stereo
nodes.text: I'm a single girlie!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you... Are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No... I'm okay...
That night, at Amanda's house..

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's what I expected to hear...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda really surprised me. Before I really knew her, I thought she was totally prissy, but she's pretty tough on the inside.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess that's what I like about her.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Really, I'm okay with Linda choosing Howard...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But I don't like her giving up on being more than just a popular girl. No offense, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You really care about her, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I think she's... Special.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, Kenji, but look on the bright side. She still really likes you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And it's not like she and Howard are married or something.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just bide your time... Who knows what could happen?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's actually... Kind of good advice.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: About Paula and that float...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well... I don't have any evidence that she `didn't` help Alexei.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I don't have any evidence that she [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] help Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! Guilty until proven innocent!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't think that's the expression...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, it's good enough for me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See ya...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And think of me when you're casting your ballot for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This school has `way` too many dances.
nodes.text_bbcode: This school has [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too many dances.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, don't tell anyone... But she thinks that choosing Howard was a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Really? She seems happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's `totally` faking it.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] faking it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know how it goes... Howard and Linda are part of the popular crowd. They have to keep up appearances.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Then it's your fault she's unhappy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You and Paula brainwashed her into only caring about looks and popularity!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But... What else would she care about?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the point of even talking about this?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You popular girls are all the same...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... So back to Paula probably helping steal the float.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know a thing about it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now... If you wouldn't mind...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'd kind of like to be alone...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot... `That` was a waste of time.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot... [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was a waste of time.

nodes.text: After school...
I need to go on the offensive!
If Paula can make a false rumor about me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then I can make a false rumor about her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But what can I say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We never did find out how Wilson High managed to sneak that Alexei guy into the school to steal our float...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It might as well have been Paula!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem... Kenji? Can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh... No... Sorry. Thought you were someone else...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh... I can see why Linda liked him... He's got muscles. And deep brown eyes... And big, strong hands...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... Kenji. Can you tell me about all that stuff with the float and Wilson High stealing it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I have reason to believe that Paula might have helped Wilson High steal the float!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're kidding, right? Why would she do that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not sure... Maybe to mess with Linda? I don't know. That's why I'm trying to get more information.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wish there was some truth to this rumor! It would make things so much easier!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: How... How is Linda, by the way?
Wait a second...
You got a perfect score!
And you know what that means... `Bonus scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And you know what that means... [b]Bonus scene![/b]

nodes.text: Near the end of the night...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, kids, it's time for the last song of the night...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: So grab that special someone and settle in for a `slow dance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So grab that special someone and settle in for a [color=#e23b3b][i]slow dance![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I'm `way` better at dancing slow than fast.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yay! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better at dancing slow than fast.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No offense, babe, but you're kind of sweaty from dancing all night.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: ...And I `really` don't want to get my suede pants wet. You understand.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] don't want to get my suede pants wet. You understand.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... I want to dance.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Then... Just go dance with some loser that doesn't have a date...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: ...Like Hector or something.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'll go wait in the car and listen to some `Blinkin' Park!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll go wait in the car and listen to some [color=#e23b3b][i]Blinkin' Park![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And elsewhere on the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I wonder where Amanda is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'd give... `Anything` just to have this last dance with her...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd give... [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything[/i][/color] just to have this last dance with her...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe if I just wish `real` hard...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if I just wish [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] hard...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I wish... I wish... `I wish!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish... I wish... [color=#e23b3b][i]I wish![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A... Amanda! Are you... Real?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... Think so!
Amanda pinches her own arm.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... Do you want to dance?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Definitely!
Well how about that... Sometimes wishes really do come true!
For example, if you wish for a new episode next week... It just might come true!
We'll see you then.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda! Amanda! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is she... Ignoring me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! Hector's going to announce the Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good evening, everybody!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have here an envelope that contains the voting totals for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Paula!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, well. If only you had a shoulder to cry on. If only you had a friend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I have Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Actually... You don't! She was the deciding vote, and I offered something you couldn't!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Friendship!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But... But you're totally mean to her!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Not as mean as you were this week.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Now if you would excuse me, I have a crown to take!
Oh no! Not only is Taylor on the bottom of the popular clique, but she lost Amanda as a friend!
This is a terrible ending!
Go back and set it right!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, who needs dates? We have each other!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Best friends forever!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! They're announcing the Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good evening, everybody!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have here an envelope that contains the voting totals for our Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Paula!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Paula won!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda... I was running against her...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry you lost.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I want to thank all the little people...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Paula won!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But mostly I want to `not` thank my enemies, like Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: But mostly I want to [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] thank my enemies, like Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait! I want to come with you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't you want to congratulate Paula?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes, but you're sad. I don't want you to be sad.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And I want ice cream! Can we have ice cream?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... I think I have some no-carb frozen yogurt hidden in the back of my mom's freezer...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
Half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love chocolate! This is my favorite!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's the third carton of frozen yogurt that you said was your favorite.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But this is my favorite now!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know... I like this better than trying to be popular.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Being popular is so much hard work.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know! And Paula was driving me crazy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... Can we still be pretty if we're not popular?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! I know! We could be smokin' hot indie chicks!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't know anything about being an indie chick...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's simple. All we need are low-rise jeans, high-tops, and black shirts, maybe black spaghetti strap tank tops.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't know anything about indie music!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't have to! Just be a little smug, and `always` be sarcastic.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't have to! Just be a little smug, and [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] be sarcastic.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I want boys to like me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Indie boys eat that stuff up! And the cuter we are, the more smug we can be!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! That's just like being popular!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! Except we have to pretend not to care about it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is great! I `already` don't understand what to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is great! I [color=#3b78e2][i]already[/i][/color] don't understand what to do!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Perfect. Just follow my lead.
Hmm... Do we really want Taylor and Amanda to trade one form of superficiality for another?
At least Taylor kept her friendship with Amanda intact.
But why don't you give Taylor another chance to turn her popularity around?

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot! I was so busy planning that I forgot to make a guy ask me out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Amanda won't return my calls...
Taylor sees Amanda on the other side of the dance floor with Zach...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Nope. She didn't want to come.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I think she said something about not wanting to run into you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `What?` Why? I'm her bestest friend!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?[/i][/color] Why? I'm her bestest friend!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Something about making her lie or giving her bad advice or something. I wasn't really paying attention.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Excellent. Hector's going to announce the Winter Court!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yay...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good evening, everybody!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have here an envelope that contains the final vote tallies for our Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Taylor!` Taylor is our new Winter Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Taylor![/i][/color] Taylor is our new Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And our new Winter King is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Zach?!
Thirty seconds later, up on stage...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You like me! You really like me!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's good to be the king.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aren't you forgetting which queen you're supposed to be with?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Doesn't matter as long as I look good.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What about Amanda? Your girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What about her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She should be your queen! Not Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But Amanda didn't win. Taylor did.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So you'd just dump Amanda for whoever is more popular?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude... Just... Not cool

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hold that thought, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, Zach. I've always thought you were hot. Want to make out?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you doing? Amanda's your friend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not anymore. Besides, you can date Amanda now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This doesn't feel right...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who cares?! I'm popular. I'm dating a hot guy, and now you can date a hot girl! Everyone's happy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's Amanda going to think about losing you as a friend?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eh. No biggie. Who needs friends anyway?
How did Taylor get so heartless?
Everyone needs friends, and popular girls are no exception, even if they don't always realize it.
Why don't you go back and try again? Amanda and Taylor deserve better.

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for going stag with me, Amanda. I was so busy planning that I forgot to get a guy to ask me out.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And Zach left me to go hang out with his football friends the second we walked in.
But wait! Don't pat yourself too much...
You didn't get the perfect ending!
C'mon, why don't you try again? You can graduate from a pat on the back to a hug from Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry about that hair comment earlier this week.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, that's all right. I went to my stylist and got myself fixed up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You go to a stylist?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A dude needs to look his best!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope he didn't pay too much for that haircut! He looks `exactly` the same!
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope he didn't pay too much for that haircut! He looks [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] the same!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taaayyyylooor! Eeeee!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hugs! Kiss, kiss!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have to go find Zach now!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Um... Nothing. I'm fine...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anyway... I have to go MC. Good luck with the vote!
At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks for dancing with me, Hector. I was so busy planning that I forgot to choose a guy to ask me out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No problem, Taylor.
Later, at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor! I heard a rumor that you've got a thing for nerds!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Just so you know, I'd be `happy` to indulge any fantasy you've got!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just so you know, I'd be [color=#e23b3b][i]happy[/i][/color] to indulge any fantasy you've got!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: As long as I don't have to wear high heels... I can't walk in heels.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I'll take that as a 'maybe'.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Just keep me in mind!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe how persistent this rumor is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I need counter-rumor support to nullify this thing ASAP!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm so hungry! Let's get a hamburger!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good one, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But hunger is the inevitable sacrifice we have to make in order to fit into our dresses.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... By the way, I need you to do a favor for me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Anything! You're my best friend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I need you to tell everyone that I wasn't kissing Spud at Hector's party.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... I wasn't `at` Hector's party!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]at[/i][/color] Hector's party!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course you were. We went together.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I `wasn't there!` I never `kissed Hector!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]wasn't there![/i][/color] I never [color=#3b78e2][i]kissed Hector![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Zach and I had a talk, and I told him that I wasn't at the party!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... But people saw you there...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I got scared! I said the first thing that came into my head!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...And that took three hours. Zach was getting suspicious!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I could really use her help...
Later that evening...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have here an envelope that contains the voting tally for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's a tie between Paula and Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: According to the rules, there can't be a tie... Did everyone turn in their official ballots?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you talking about this list of pretty people's names?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I circled Taylor's name a bunch of times! And I added little hearts! She's my best friend!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's good enough for me... `Taylor wins!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's good enough for me... [color=#e23b3b][i]Taylor wins![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That traitor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe if you had treated Amanda better, you would have won!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Maybe if you hadn't spread that rumor about the float I would have won!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wouldn't have done that if you hadn't spread that rumor about Spud!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Looks like you can dish it out, but you can't take it, huh?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You may have won the crown, but you haven't won the school, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I'll be queen of this place again. Watch your back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Bye bye now! I'll be sure to send you a picture of me in the tiara!
And so, a few minutes later up on stage...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Um... Amanda shouldn't be up here. She didn't win anything.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not going to burst her bubble. Why ruin the moment?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Isn't Taylor the best best friend ever?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's cooler than I thought.
Not bad! Taylor's now in charge, and there will be a softer, gentler regime in Centerscore...
Plus, Taylor and Amanda are still best friends!
Give yourself a pat on the back for a job well done!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Zach... Have you seen Amanda around?
Later, in class...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda... Do you know how many guys you've accidently kissed in the last year?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know... But... I like Hector...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... You `like` like him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... You [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] like him?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He's so cute! And nice! And funny!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I'm Zach's girlfriend! I don't understand what I should do!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is perfect! If I can get Amanda to dump Zach and go after Hector, he'll totally owe me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that could really pay off when it's time to vote for Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um... Anyway... I need your help with this Paula rumor.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do you really think that Paula helped Wilson steal the float?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um... No, and that's the problem. I need your help spreading the rumor more.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want you to tell people that you saw her talking to Alexei before the float disappeared.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... I never saw Paula do that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `know...` I'm asking you to `lie` for me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]know...[/i][/color] I'm asking you to [color=#3b78e2][i]lie[/i][/color] for me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I already lied to Zach! I can't lie again! It's too hard remembering what I said!
That Friday night...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Campaigning is done. Planning is done.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All that's left now is voting, dancing... And winning!
After school...
I need to go on the offensive!
If Paula can make a false rumor about me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then I can make a false rumor about her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But what can I say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We never did find out how Wilson High managed to sneak that Alexei guy into the school to steal our float...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It might as well have been Paula!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem... Kenji? Can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh... No... Sorry. Thought you were someone else...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh... I can see why Linda liked him... He's got muscles. And deep brown eyes... And big, strong hands...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... Kenji. Can you tell me about all that stuff with the float and Wilson High stealing it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I have reason to believe that Paula might have helped Wilson High steal the float!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're kidding, right? Why would she do that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not sure... Maybe to mess with Linda? I don't know. That's why I'm trying to get more information.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wish there was some truth to this rumor! It would make things so much easier!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: How... How is Linda, by the way?
At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Zach... Have you seen Amanda around?
At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for going stag with me, Amanda. I was so busy planning that I forgot to get a guy to ask me out.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And Zach left me to go hang out with his football friends the second we walked in.
At the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot! I was so busy planning that I forgot to make a guy ask me out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Amanda won't return my calls...
Taylor sees Amanda on the other side of the dance floor with Zach...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow... Hector seemed really upset at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He... He did?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You seem pretty concerned... Is there anything you want to confess?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay... I confess... I don't know how zippers work... That's why all my fleeces are pullovers!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I meant a confession about `Hector.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant a confession about [color=#3b78e2][i]Hector.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Don't tell Zach, but I accidentally kissed Hector...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Twice!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { I'm a single girlie! {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { I'm a single girlie! {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor! I haven't seen you in, like, forever!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forever meaning three hours ago?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hugs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why are you so happy?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have the bestest friend in the whole world!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Thanks, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { I'm a single girlie! {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { I'm a single girlie! {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry that you're not here with Amanda... I tried my best.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's all right. I'm a guy. I'm supposed to move on. There are plenty of hot fish in the sea... Of women...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not going to start crying are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: N... No way! Maybe... Maybe tears of `joy` cause I'm so glad to be single!
nodes.text_bbcode: N... No way! Maybe... Maybe tears of [color=#e23b3b][i]joy[/i][/color] cause I'm so glad to be single!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taaayyyylooor! Eeeee!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hugs! Kiss, kiss!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... Um...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector looks so heartbroken...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you going to say something gross about two girls hugging?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? Um... Er...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way. Why interrupt a good show?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aw... Do you want a hug too?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Um... I guess... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You smell like the mall!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hehe. That's probably my 'Haxe Body Spray'. I used a whole can.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... I'd better get going... Over there.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll see you two later.
